title: Johnson's first meeting after Kecksburg was with the head of emergency management

tellings.quote: covered and that the head of FEMA was there the day after the first meeting that that Johnson had when he came back to the White House after Kexsburg was with the head FEMA with the emergency management.

plain: After the 1965 Kecksburg incident, when an object reportedly fell from the sky in Pennsylvania, President Lyndon Johnson's first meeting back at the White House is said to have been with the head of emergency management. The Canadian UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels that 'the head of FEMA was there the day after', though he names no document. If so, the incident would have been treated at the top as an emergency.
